issues.claim: Andrej Karpathy traces its spelling mistakes back to tokenization.
issues.problem: 'its' is ambiguous (the AI's). Karpathy's lecture notes give a one-line attribution ('Why can't LLM spell words? Tokenization.') and call it a source of weirdness, not the sole cause.
issues.fix: Andrej Karpathy points to tokenization as a reason language models struggle with spelling.

issues.claim: So when it fumbles spelling, blame the chunks.
issues.problem: Rhetorical; implies tokenization is the only cause, while sources say it is a main contributor.
issues.fix: So when it fumbles spelling, the chunks are a big part of why.
